--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.ZModChar
/-- The value of `χ₄ n`, for `n : ℤ`, depends only on `n % 4`. -/
theorem χ₄_int_mod_four (n : ℤ) : χ₄ n = χ₄ (n % 4 : ℤ) := by
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_mod n 4, Nat.cast_ofNat]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sZMod_eq_sMod (p : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod p i = (sMod p i : ZMod (2 ^ p - 1)) := by
  induction i <;> push_cast [← Int.coe_nat_two_pow_pred p, sMod, sZMod, *] <;> rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Part
theorem mod_mem_mod [Mod α] (a b : Part α) (ma mb : α) (ha : ma ∈ a) (hb : mb ∈ b) :
    ma % mb ∈ a % b := by simp [mod_def]; aesop

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.EuclideanDomain.Basic
theorem gcd_val (a b : R) : gcd a b = gcd (b % a) a := by
  rw [gcd]
  split_ifs with h <;> [simp only [h, mod_zero, gcd_zero_right]; rfl]

--src: Mathlib.Dynamics.PeriodicPts
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem zpow_mod_period_smul (j : ℤ) {g : G} {a : α} :
    g ^ (j % (period g a : ℤ)) • a = g ^ j • a := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Int.emod_add_ediv j (period g a), zpow_add, mul_smul,
    zpow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd.mpr (dvd_mul_right _ _)]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_aux_eq (q k : ℕ) : sModNat_aux (4 % q) q k = sModNat q k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [sModNat_aux, ih, sModNat, ← ih]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.Basic
/-- The Legendre symbol depends only on `a` mod `p`. -/
protected theorem mod (a : ℤ) : legendreSym p a = legendreSym p (a % p) := by
  simp only [legendreSym, intCast_mod]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Part
@[simp]
theorem mod_get_eq [Mod α] (a b : Part α) (hab : Dom (a % b)) :
    (a % b).get hab = a.get (left_dom_of_mod_dom hab) % b.get (right_dom_of_mod_dom hab) := by
  simp [mod_def]; aesop

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sMod_mod (p i : ℕ) : sMod p i % (2 ^ p - 1) = sMod p i := by cases i <;> simp [sMod]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem mod_modEq (a n) : a % n ≡ a [MOD n] :=
  mod_mod _ _
